about: Drift is not an error: one question with several homes is a point with several origins. It becomes an error only
where the homes stop agreeing, and then the point splits and names the pair — the place where a copy went wrong.

cases.name: four homes that agree are drift without error
two homes that disagree split and are named

coverage.criterion: one home, four that agree, two that disagree
coverage.why: one question; four agreeing homes stand for any number
